'''Gueni''' was the leader of the [[Daan Council]] in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]] during the long-time [[Melida/Daan Civil War]]. He was forced to wear a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] to keep him alive due to injuries received during the war. His grandson, [[Rica]], was a member of [[the Young]].<ref name="DotD" />

When the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Mission to Melida/Daan|arrived]] on [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]], Gueni was forced into an alliance with Melida head [[Wehutti]] to control the Young and avoid an all out [[Young–Elders War|war]].<ref name="DotD" />
